assets.name: Lolly Spin (animated)
assets.description: The Lolly swirl as a self-contained animated SVG - three nested spirals rotating at a calm 9/18/27s cadence (the mark's own motion, slowed for comfort) with a slow hue drift on a brand-tinted gradient, calmed under prefers-reduced-motion. The swirl and the background inherit the active brand's colours when placed live, and it makes a handy default subject for testing filters, grading and animation. A removable example - delete it any time.

assets.name: App screenshot (demo)
assets.description: A real Lolly screenshot - the brand studio's Colours tab, captured as vector by the app's own DOM-to-SVG walker. A demo subject for flythroughs, filters and layered animation. A removable example - delete it any time.

assets.name: SUSE brand standards
assets.description: The SUSE brand team's official brand standards for generative AI work: company position, boilerplate and tagline, logo use, colour, typography and capitalisation.

skill.name: suse-brand
skill.description: The SUSE brand team's official brand standards: company position, boilerplate and tagline, logo use, the colour palette and approved combinations, typography, capitalisation and layout. Read this first for any SUSE work, whatever the medium.
skill.revisionNote: Two spelling fixes approved by the brand owner: "bacground" is now "background" and "Watehole" is now "Waterhole". The text is otherwise the brand team's version 1 as supplied.

assets.name: SUSE production notes
assets.description: Lolly-maintained production notes for SUSE artwork: PMS builds, tonal ramps, gradients, logo markup, voice and the house component rules.

skill.name: suse-production-notes
skill.description: SUSE production notes maintained by Lolly - PMS builds, tonal ramps, gradients, logo markup, voice and the house component rules for SUSE artwork. Read the SUSE brand standards (suse-brand) first; they are the official source and win wherever the two differ.
skill.revisionNote: Moved into the SUSE catalog as a brand skill. The three Lolly app conventions (Escape closes overlays, never fight browser defaults, Lolly code reads tokens) moved to Lolly's own guidance.

assets.name: SUSE iconography
assets.description: A working specification for drawing additions to the SUSE icon family: artboard, line weight, the two colour roles, padding and review refinements.

skill.name: suse-iconography
skill.description: How to draw a new SUSE icon or a new version of one so it belongs in the SUSE icon family: the 40 by 40 artboard, line weight, the two colour roles (.c1 and .c2), padding, recognition first, and what review looks for. Use whenever you draw, edit or review a SUSE icon.
